decision.explanation: All three positions are explicitly supported by the provided source texts. D1S11 confirms 'Member of the Abgeordnetenhaus' (House of Representatives of the former Austrian Imperial Council). D2S3 confirms 'Member of the Australian House of Representatives.' D2S5 confirms 'Member of the Czech Council.' These are distinct roles held by the same individual at different times or contexts, and there is no evidence of contradiction among them. Complementary answers are preserved per instruction.
